pensamiento:
I'm checking QUS-001 against the criteria: the role "parent" and the action are both there, so it passes, though the phrasing is in English. The story is missing a benefit clause, but the criterion only requires role and action, so I'm weighing whether that gap is worth flagging as a note or whether only actual defects should be reported.

I'm running through the remaining criteria one by one. QUS-002 and QUS-003 look fine, and QUS-005 has nothing technical to flag. The missing benefit is the real issue: QUS-004 has nothing to evaluate, so I'll treat it under INV-002 as a defect rather than a separate failure.

I'm checking the invariants next: INV-001 looks independent since no dependencies are mentioned, but INV-002 fails because there's no stated benefit, and INV-003 fails because the forms, fields, and management process are unspecified. For INV-004 the scope is too vague to estimate, so I'll record it as 1 under the rule for stories without an estimable scope.

I'm going through the last invariant and DOR checks: INV-005 has no acceptance criteria, so it's a blocking defect. For DOR-001 the story names a "camp management" system as the destination for submitted forms without naming it as an explicit dependency, so I'm weighing whether that counts as a defect.

I'm settling on the verdict: the story is sent back, with defects in QUS-006, INV-002, INV-003, INV-005 and DOR-002. I'm still weighing whether QUS-004 should be cited for the missing benefit, since the criterion asks for a justification and there isn't one.

I'm settling on the defects to report: QUS-006, INV-002, INV-003, INV-005 and DOR-002, with QUS-004 folded into INV-002 rather than cited twice. Since the scope can't be estimated, the estimate is 1. For the refined story I'm drafting a Spanish version with placeholders for the form type and the benefit, so I don't invent any scope.

I'm settling the recommendations for each defect in Spanish, leaving the type as functional, and since the schema wants an array but acceptance criteria only apply when a story is accepted, I'll pass an empty one.

Explicitar el beneficio en la parte 'para…' (por ejemplo, para que el campista sea admitido o para no entregar papeles en persona). Confirmar con el product owner cuál es el valor para el padre o para el campamento.

Indicar qué formularios entran en alcance, qué datos debe capturar cada uno, qué pasa tras el envío (confirmación, estado) y si hay integraciones. Sin esto el equipo no puede estimar. Agregar criterios de aceptación observables, por ejemplo: 'Al enviar un formulario válido, el sistema muestra confirmación y el formulario queda registrado'. Hoy la HU no trae ninguno.
